cabric: CaBric Engineering is a full-spectrum housing and infrastructure solutions company operating between Cameroon and Europe.
cab2: Led by two civil engineers, CaBric covers the full lifecycle of a construction project — from architectural design and engineering studies, through project management and construction execution, to property management and innovation research.
cab3: The company was founded on a simple belief: every person, regardless of income, deserves access to quality housing and safe infrastructure. CaBric begins by building credibility through premium clients, then uses that foundation to scale sustainable and affordable solutions for wider communities.
miss: To provide inclusive and innovative solutions that enhance the planning, construction, and management of infrastructure, promoting balanced, sustainable communities.
vis: To actively co-create better living conditions for people in communities through accessible, safe, and durable housing and infrastructure solutions.
prob: Poor construction standards and safety, absence of professional project management, disconnect between design innovation and local context, limited access to sustainable building practices, and a chronic gap between what clients are promised and what gets delivered.
chris: Christopher is a hands-on engineer who leads from the field. With extensive experience in structural design, site supervision, road construction, and building digitization, he is known for his precision and accountability. As Co-founder of ILID, he has advanced infrastructure innovation nationally, leading teams, managing challenges, and transforming ideas into practical solutions. At CaBric, Christopher remains the dependable expert clients count on for everything from groundbreaking to completion handover.
brice: Brice's career bridges engineering excellence with tangible impact. He has overseen residential building rehabilitations in Yaoundé, designed climate-resilient bridges, and won first place at a top French engineering innovation contest. With proven skills in design, construction, and sustainability, he is a co-founder of ILID. Now based in Paris, Brice directs CaBric's expansion across Europe and the diaspora, linking global ambitions with African goals.
cab4: CaBric is built on trust and open communication, and accountability, combining engineering rigour with human-centered design to deliver projects across Cameroon with an international perspective.
trans: CaBric is built on trust and open communication, and accountability, combining engineering rigour with human-centered design to deliver projects across Cameroon with an international perspective.
transtext: Clear, honest communication maintained at every stage of each project.
